decisions.reason: This optical spectrum connectivity service builds directly on the firm's fibre, carrier and engineering capabilities, so under an absorptive-capacity logic the firm can understand customer feedback well and improve it within its core strategic move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure.

Although the portal fits the firm's software and service-operations knowledge, it sits in a more mature voice niche and is easier to absorb into broader provisioning systems, making a standalone offer less likely to justify continued focus.
